sql.if: AND (b.borrow_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR a.asset_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR a.asset_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.sql: FROM ca_borrow b JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=b.asset_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=b.applicant_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT b.borrow_id,b.borrow_no,b.asset_id,b.asset_dept_id,b.applicant_user_id,b.purpose, b.planned_start_time,b.planned_end_time,b.status,b.apply_time,b.audit_user_id,b.audit_time,b.audit_opinion, b.actual_pickup_time,b.actual_return_time,b.cancel_user_id,b.cancel_time,b.cancel_reason, a.asset_code,a.asset_name,u.nick_name applicant_name WHERE 1=1 AND b.status=#{status} AND b.status IN ('3','4') AND b.planned_end_time < NOW(3) AND b.status IN ('3','4') AND b.planned_end_time BETWEEN NOW(3) AND DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{remindHours} HOUR) ORDER BY b.apply_time DESC,b.borrow_id DESC

SELECT b.borrow_id,b.asset_id WHERE b.status IN ('3','4') AND b.planned_end_time <= DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{remindHours} HOUR) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ca_message m WHERE m.receiver_user_id=b.applicant_user_id AND m.event_key=CONCAT('BORROW:',b.borrow_id,':',IF(b.planned_end_time < NOW(3),'OVERDUE','DUE_SOON')))
ORDER BY b.planned_end_time,b.borrow_id LIMIT 100
mapper.sql: FROM ca_handover h JOIN ca_borrow b ON b.borrow_id=h.borrow_id JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=b.asset_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=b.applicant_user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ca_borrow SET status=#{status},update_by=#{actor},update_time=NOW(3) ,actual_pickup_time=NOW(3) ,actual_return_time=NOW(3) WHERE borrow_id=#{id} AND status=#{expected}
